The global PSI (40) and US PSI (40) reinforce a broadly bearish backdrop, yet Europe’s mixed PSI (49) and the divergent top‑mover moves—energy stocks sharply down, CPI up, and TRON falling—highlight sector‑specific contrasts. Consensus is high on bearish bias for rates and AI, but many topics retain conflicting coverage, indicating no single narrative drives market direction.
